notes.title: PROPHUNT - Patch Notes: Early Access v0.5.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're back with PROPHUNT update v0.5.1! From now on, updates will be lighter in content but more regular. We expect at least 1 update per month. Here's an overview of what's changed!

[h3]ADDED[/h3]

[list]
[*] A [url=https://trello.com/b/Alrlii9Z]roadmap[/url] is available online to give an overview of the additions we want to make to PROPHUNT
[*] Message in chat when someone joins and leaves the game
[*] Bug report button
[*] Add a “HOST” label to indicate the game's host player
[*] Firearm damage indicator
[*] Added ability to see allies through walls
[/list]

[h3]UPDATED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Balancing weapon values (damage, rate of fire, etc.)
[*] Improvements and modifications to numerous interfaces
[*] The default game mode is now swap
[*] Changes to various minor elements of the game
[*] Game engine updated to Unreal Engine 5.4.4 for improved performance and bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed interaction problems with certain interfaces and pop-ups
[*] Various bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]JOIN THE COMMUNITY[/h3]
If you also want to participate in the development of the game, you can join us on our social networks:

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/VenalithStudio]X (Twitter)[/url]

notes.title: PROPHUNT - Patch Notes: Early Access v0.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're delighted to announce the release of PROPHUNT Early Access 0.5 today! This new version fixes over fifty bugs, adds new features, modifies numerous game elements and lays the foundations for our new vision of PROPHUNT. More updates coming soon!

[h3]ADDED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Soundboard for props to taunt hunters ("BETA" feature)
[*] Double jump for props with sound played on second jump ("BETA" feature not enabled by default)
[*] Advanced fireworks color customization
[*] Option to customize the color of each team in the settings
[/list]

[h3]UPDATED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Rework of the "Warehouse" map
[*] Anti-AFK for props has been released from its "BETA" phase and is now enabled by default. Launching a taunt will now stop anti-AFK, and other bugs have been fixed
[*] All user interfaces have been redesigned, including new features, optimizations and numerous text and bug fixes
[*] The font has been changed to allow translations to be implemented in future updates.
[*] Lighting and shadows have been made fully dynamic using LUMEN technology
[*] The fireworks particle has been reworked to make it more visible and customizable
[*] Custom key assignment has been temporarily deactivated to make way for a "QWERTY" or "AZERTY" configuration
[*] The damage taken by hunters when touching a false prop is now 2 instead of 4
[*] Chat now remains invisible even when activated if no message is sent during the game
[*] Project migration from Unreal Engine 4.27 to Unreal Engine 5.2 including performance improvements, bug fixes and stability enhancements
[*] The in-game "News" button now leads to PROPHUNT's Steam news hub
[/list]

[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] A problem prevented props from replaying a taunt after the first one
[*] Taunt points were sometimes attributed to the game host
[*] A problem sometimes prevented hunters from spawning on the map
[*] A problem sometimes prevented team swapping between rounds.
[*] Code optimization including network optimization and improved stability
[*] Many animation problems fixed
[*] Many sound problems have been fixed
[*] Many collision problems fixed
[*] Many problems with 3D models have been fixed
[*] Many improvements and fixes have been applied to game elements
[/list]

[h3]REMOVED[/h3]

[list]
[*] The "Police Station" map has been removed as it didn't work well with in-game features
[*] Saving and loading match settings has been removed to make it easier to add new game settings for next updates
[*] The "Help" menu has been removed to speed up the production of new updates
[/list]

[h3]JOIN THE COMMUNITY[/h3]
If you also want to participate in the development of the game, you can join us on our social networks:

[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/VenalithStudio]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfRvBkvy0EP7IvbS100DInQ]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@venalith]TikTok[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/venalithstudio/]Instragram[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/Venalith]Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/venalith]Twitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.venalith.com/]Our Website[/url]
[/list]
[b]You can report bugs or suggest improvements on [url=https://discord.com/invite/qCruRUa]our Discord server[/url] or on the Steam Community Hub, we read all your messages![/b]

notes.title: All the new features coming to PROPHUNT
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we're going to show you all the features that are coming to PROPHUNT.

First of all, we are migrating the project to Unreal Engine 5 the brand new game engine from Epic Games more powerful than ever. This migration includes significant performance boosts as well as a dramatic improvement to the game's lighting system that simulates lights in real time! The improved lighting system will allow us to integrate night mode game maps for more strategy and in-game possibilities.

A brand new map will appear in the map pool: the "Castle" map. We will show you more about it later.

In addition, many gameplay mechanics have evolved but will also be added:

[list]
[*] the anti AFK for props comes out of its BETA phase and will now be activated by default on all games.
[*] the props are getting two new gameplay mechanics that are the dynamic noises in game controlled by a customizable soundboard and a double jump (option available during the game setup).
[/list]
We have also made a facelift of the user interfaces by making them more modern and cleaner. They are now fully optimized, stable and a new font is used to make it easier for us to translate the game into other languages later. Not to mention the code and networking which we have significantly optimized to avoid in-game slowdowns and server saturation.

Finally, we have fixed many recurring bugs that are harmful to the game experience:

[list]
[*] fixed an issue that prevented clients from playing a firework again
[*] fixed an issue where an assigned key was deleted and could not be reassigned
[*] added checks when assigning a new key to prevent setting problems
[*] fixed an issue that prevented hunters from spawn in some circumstances
[*] fixed a problem that prevented the swap of teams to be done correctly
[/list]
And much more very soon to be seen in PROPHUNT!

[h3]JOIN THE COMMUNITY[/h3]
If you also want to participate in the development of the game, you can join us on our social networks:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfRvBkvy0EP7IvbS100DInQ]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/VenalithStudio]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/venalith]Twitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.venalith.com/]Website[/url]
[/list]
[b]You can report bugs or suggest improvements on [url=https://discord.com/invite/qCruRUa]our Discord server[/url] or on the Steam Community Hub, we read all your messages![/b]

notes.title: PROPHUNT - Patch Notes: Early Access v0.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone, welcome to the brand new version 0.4 of PROPHUNT which refines the game and adds a lot of new content but also some in-game balancing.

As this version reworks almost the entire game and its infrastructure, there will be no detailed patch notes but only the biggest additions of the update. The vast majority of the code and netcode has been improved and optimized to avoid in-game annoyances.

[h3]REWORK[/h3]
The Bunker map has been reworked! It is now much more balanced, varied and fun to walk around. We've changed the layout of the props and we've also shortened the maze that was getting boring.

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
All gameplay as a hunter has been revised. We have integrated four robot classes each with their own specificities and gameplay mechanics, and of course it comes with a much improved arsenal! Come hunt props with a machine gun, heavy machine gun, assault rifle, grenade launcher, pistol and shotgun. The hunting games will be even more interesting and strategic.

Of course we are not leaving the props aside and we are developing new gameplay mechanics for them. You will know more in the next updates!

[h3]BUFF[/h3]
The Police Station map has been slightly modified to be more pleasant and less chaotic to play.

[h3]INTERFACE[/h3]
All interface designs have been revised to be more modern and intuitive. Moreover, the sound effects have also been improved to be more pleasant and less... surprising.

[h3]LAN[/h3]
We have added LAN support in the game so that you can play only in this type of configuration, it can be more pleasant to find games with only people connected to the same internet network as you.

We still have a lot of things to improve and add in future updates like improving character animations and sound effects, but it's a long and expensive work, we hope you'll be lenient about it.

[h3]JOIN THE COMMUNITY[/h3]
If you also want to participate in the development of the game, you can join us on our social networks:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfRvBkvy0EP7IvbS100DInQ]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/VenalithStudio]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/venalith]Twitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.venalith.com/]Website[/url]
[/list]
[b]You can report bugs or suggest improvements on [url=https://discord.com/invite/qCruRUa]our Discord server[/url] or on the Steam Community Hub, we read all your messages![/b]

notes.title: PROPHUNT - Patch Notes: Early Access v0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is a new update that greatly improves the quality of life of the game while adding several new features that you suggested. We have also decided to change the way we write the patch notes in order to better classify the new features into clear categories so that you can better find your way around:

[h3]REWORK[/h3]
The Hangar map has been revamped and improved by removing unnecessary areas to be more balanced. The light and shadow management has been greatly improved and we have optimized the performance in game.

[h3]GAMEPLAY[/h3]
We have also added a new gameplay element: anti-AFK for props. This will prevent props from staying in one place for the duration of the game to force them to move during the game. This feature is experimental, we would love to receive your feedback on it in order to improve it and modify it accordingly.

[h3]ADDED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added an indication of the remaining time of the round as well as the number of hunters and props still alive
[*] Added a text chat allowing to communicate with all players of the game or only with his team
[*] Added the possibility to set the time to hide to 90 seconds
[*] Added a reload sound for all weapons
[*] Added keystroke indication that they were not before
[/list]

[h3]CHANGED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Improved the player's camera position
[*] Improved the user interface in game
[*] Changed the default number of rounds of the game to 5 instead of 10
[*] Changed the default run length from 180 seconds to 240 seconds
[*] Improved the repulsion effect of the repulsive grenade
[*] The grenade launcher's repulsive grenades now explode on contact
[*] The range of the grenade launcher has been increased
[*] Improved the camera zoom when aiming
[*] Decreased the number of grenades from 3 to 2
[*] Improved management of weapon sounds
[*] Disabled motion blur to avoid nausea during long game sessions
[*] Improved the game's texture compression method to greatly reduce its weight
[*] Significantly improved in-game performance
[/list]

[h3]FIXED[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented sound settings from saving
[*] Fixed a certain type of setting that prevented the game from starting
[*] Fixed jump sounds not playing if you jump directly after landing on the ground
[*] Fixed a problem that did not display the last player to join the game when he completed the maximum number of players that could join the match
[*] Fixed a problem that prevented the player to play in a team when doing a certain manipulation
[*] Fixed a problem that prevented the player to play if he joined the game during the preparation phase by joining the props team
[*] Fixed the rotation of the weapon in the hands of the hunter so that the weapon points precisely in front of her
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon's firing delay could be removed between shots
[*] Fixed multiple issues that affected the character's speed when performing certain manipulations
[*] Fixed an issue that made it difficult to transform into a props depending on the camera zoom
[*] Fixed some texts
[*] Fixed various user interface problems
[*] Fixed some level design issues
[*] Fixed an issue with the Discord API
[/list]

If you also want to participate in the development of the game, you can join us on our social networks:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfRvBkvy0EP7IvbS100DInQ]Youtube[/url]

[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/venalith]Twitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.venalith.com/]Website[/url]
[/list]
[b]You can report bugs or suggest improvements on [url=https://discord.com/invite/qCruRUa]our Discord server[/url] or on the Steam Community Hub, we read all your messages![/b]

notes.title: PROPHUNT - Patch Notes: Early Access v0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is the first update to PROPHUNT which fixes a significant number of reported bugs and issues. It also adds some features suggested by the community via the Steam Hub and our Discord server:

[h3]FEATURES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added various tips during loading times
[*] Dynamic realistic footsteps sounds added
[*] Added management of different sounds in game
[*] The gravity is 2.8x higher than the old one to be more realistic
[*] Improved user interface to make it more readable
[*] Added icon showing the key associated with its action
[*] Jumps are now much more realistic
[/list]

[h3]PROPS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Decrease of the point gain by launching a firework from 50 points to 25
[*] Visual and auditory improvement of the fireworks making it much more detectable in space by the hunters
[*] Fixed a problem with the display of the point gain UI with the fireworks taunt
[/list]

[h3]HUNTERS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added automatic reloading when the weapon has no bullet left in the magazine
[*] The camera movement is now smoother when crouching
[*] The camera goes down a little bit when you crouch, allowing you to better see the elements on the ground
[*] The magazine disappears during the reloading animation
[*] Fixed left hand not resting correctly on the extended weapon
[*] The damage when shooting a bad prop is reduced from 5 points of damage to 4
[*] Invisible walls no longer stop bullets
[*] The FOV when zooming increases from 45 to 55 degrees to avoid nausea when zooming too much
[/list]

[h3]SPECTATOR MODE[/h3]

[list]
[*] We can only see that the people in his team
[*] The camera no longer passes through walls
[*] As a prop, the name of the player who killed us appears in capital letters like the rest of the text in the interface
[*] The camera in spectator mode follows the movements of the player you are watching
[/list]

[h3]PASSWORD-PROTECTED MATCH[/h3]

[list]
[*] The password entry in the text field is now visually protected
[*] The password can be seen by checking an option
[/list]

[h3]SERVER BROWSER[/h3]

[list]
[*] The text showing a mandatory ping of 9999ms has been removed because it did not fit with reality
[*] Added failure and success sounds when joining a session from the browser server
[/list]

[h3]WAREHOUSE[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed some collision boxes to avoid some problems
[*] Correction of some misplaced elements
[*] Fixed a critical flaw that removed the client interface when doing a certain manipulation
[/list]

[h3]POLICE STATION[/h3]

[list]
[*] Correction of some misplaced elements
[/list]

[h3]HANGAR[/h3]

[list]
[*] Correction of the pivots of the piles of concrete bricks
[*] Fixed some incorrect collisions
[/list]

[h3]MISCELLANEOUS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed invalid URL redirection
[*] Correction of some inaccurate English translation
[*] Fixed various user interface issues
[*] The text announcing the winning team at the end of a task no longer flashes before marking the name of the winning team
[*] Fixed problem with Discord API
[/list]

If you also want to participate in the development of the game, you can join us on our social networks:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfRvBkvy0EP7IvbS100DInQ]Youtube[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/VenalithStudio]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/venalith]Twitch[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.venalith.com/]Website[/url]
[/list]
[b]You can report bugs or suggest improvements on [url=https://discord.com/invite/qCruRUa]our Discord server[/url] or on the Steam Community Hub, we read all your messages![/b]
